patch_description:
This implementation replaces random Gaussian points with a deterministic constrained maximin optimization.

It directly optimizes 14 three-dimensional points under the normalization that every pairwise distance is at most one, while maximizing the minimum squared pairwise distance. Since the evaluator uses the squared minimum-to-maximum distance ratio, this is equivalent to the desired objective after normalization.

The optimizer starts from a structured cube-plus-axis configuration and several deterministic perturbations, uses analytic constraint Jacobians when SciPy is available, and retains the best feasible result. A normalized structured fallback is included if SciPy is unavailable or optimization fails. The returned array always has shape `(14, 3)`, finite values, and positive maximum pairwise distance.
